info.title: Kadé gateway-rider
info.description: Backend-for-frontend for the rider app (apps/rider). Money is whole rupees (LKR). Errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`. Mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Realtime: WebSocket /ws (see the gateway README). Rider routes act for the caller's dispatch rider id, resolved with dispatch RiderService.GetMyRider. Positions are map units of the app's illustrated map.

MapPoint.description: Point on the illustrated 400 × 600 Colombo map.
